h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Madurai

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Madurai

c: Madurai's day starts early. Long before the shops open around the Meenakshi Amman Temple, walkers are out in the city's parks and on the Vaigai riverfront. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Madurai for these parks, schools, colleges, hospitals with large grounds and residential layouts. We make our machines at our factory in Vasai, about 1190 km away.

The equipment travels to Tamil Nadu by road, and our installation team or a dealer in south India fixes it on site. Madurai is hot and dry for much of the year, with most of its rain coming late in the year from the northeast monsoon. Strong afternoon sun is the main concern. We suggest siting the gym under trees or a shade structure, and a light-coloured paver base stays cooler than dark stone.

items.q: Is the summer sun in Madurai a problem for outdoor gym machines?
items.a: The galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are made for outdoor heat. Shade is about the user's comfort, so place the machines under trees or a pergola and encourage early or evening use.

items.q: Can a hospital or college in Madurai set up an outdoor gym?
items.a: Yes. Large grounds with a walking path work well. Send us the site plan or photos and the expected users, and we will suggest machines and a layout for approval.

items.q: How do I get a quote for Madurai?
items.a: Call +91 902 830 2266 or email sales@funplaysystems.com with the site size, photos and the users you expect. Our sales team works Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM.
